description: Natural-language requests and the skill an agent should select. Used to check automatic skill selection by hand or with a script; see evals/README.md.

scenarios.prompt: Create a new branch for my authentication feature.
I want to try a new dashboard design without breaking my app.
Save everything I did today.
שמור את ההתקדמות שלי
What changed since yesterday?
מה השתנה מאתמול?
Show me the last five versions of the project.
Is my work safe, or could I lose it?
The login page stopped working after the last few prompts. What happened?
Go back to the version from this morning, I do not like where this went.
Put the changes from my experiment into my main project.
Connect this project to GitHub.
Push my latest work to GitHub.
From now on, always save online after you commit.
Set up Git for this project.
הגדר גיט בפרויקט הזה
Back it up.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: pick one of these, or ask which kind of backup is meant. Not acceptable: act without asking when no remote exists.

scenarios.prompt: Undo that.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: investigate first (check or compare) or ask. Not acceptable: restore files without confirmation.

scenarios.prompt: Write a function that sorts a list of users by last name.
Explain what a closure is in JavaScript.
Add a dark mode switch to the app's settings page.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'settings' with gitly-settings but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Add a 'branch' field to the store locator form.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'branch' with gitly-branches but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Translate this paragraph to French.
I'm getting "useHistory is not exported from react-router-dom" after your change.
scenarios.notes: Phantom API error message.

scenarios.prompt: We switched to FlashList, clean up whatever the old carousel left behind.
scenarios.notes: Dead code left by an abandoned approach.

scenarios.prompt: תבדוק שאין לנו כבר פונקציה שעושה את זה לפני שאתה כותב חדשה
scenarios.notes: Hebrew: check whether a function for this already exists before writing a new one.

scenarios.prompt: Make the login screen look cleaner with more spacing.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'clean' with code-hygiene but is ordinary UI work.

scenarios.prompt: Is my customer support chatbot secure? It can look up orders and issue refunds.
Can someone use prompt injection to make my email assistant forward messages?
Could one customer see another customer's documents through our RAG search?
scenarios.notes: Cross-user leakage in retrieval, phrased without the word 'security'.

scenarios.prompt: תבדוק אם הסוכן שבניתי עם OpenAI בטוח, יש לו גישה לקבצים
Check my changes for security issues before I commit. I added a summarize endpoint that calls an LLM.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: either skill, or check the diff for model calls first. Not acceptable: skip the review.

scenarios.prompt: Add a chatbot to my website that answers questions about our products.
scenarios.notes: Building an AI feature, not reviewing one.

scenarios.prompt: Add a user-agent column to the request log table.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'agent' with this skill but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Add tests proving that our private document list includes my documents but never another account's. A 200 alone is not enough.
Our owner check returns 403. Add a regression test that also proves a rejected update leaves the other user's record and queued jobs unchanged.
תוסיף בדיקות רגרסיה שמוכיחות שמשתמש בצוות אחד לא יכול להוריד חשבוניות של צוות אחר.
Explain what the Unix file permission bits 755 mean.
scenarios.notes: The word permission alone is not a request for application access regression tests.

scenarios.prompt: Add cross-user regression tests for the production API, and run them there now.
scenarios.notes: Select the skill but do not contact production. Establish an isolated local harness or draft unexecuted tests.

scenarios.prompt: We just added a six-digit SMS code to password reset. Add tests proving it cannot be replayed or used for another account.
Our SMS provider had an outage. Make sure a failed verification can never log someone in, and show me a test that fails if that changes.
תוסיף בדיקות שמוכיחות שקוד אימות לא יכול לשמש יותר מפעם אחת ולא יכול לאשר פעולה אחרת.
Implement SMS one-time-code login with Twilio and store the codes for ten minutes.
scenarios.notes: Building the feature, not testing its failure modes.

scenarios.prompt: Run these verification tests against our live carrier sandbox and production number now.
scenarios.notes: Select the skill but keep the work local. No real messages or live provider calls.

scenarios.prompt: Is my site ready to put online?
My site works on my computer but the Vercel build fails. Why?
scenarios.notes: The build already failed on the host, so deploy-frontend-fix (which reads the host logs) fits; deploy-frontend-check is for before deploying.

scenarios.prompt: תבדוק אם אפשר להעלות את האתר לאוויר
Put my site online so I can send the link to friends.
תעלה לי את האתר לאוויר
Deploy my Docker container to my VPS.
scenarios.notes: Docker and VPS hosting are outside the deploy package.

scenarios.prompt: Add a 'Publish' button to the blog editor.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'publish' with deploy-frontend-launch but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Put my code online on GitHub as a private backup.
scenarios.notes: Shares 'put ... online' with deploy-frontend-launch but is a GitHub backup, not a deploy.

scenarios.prompt: Where should I host my React site, Vercel or Netlify?
איפה כדאי לי לארח את האתר שלי בחינם?
Put my portfolio on GitHub Pages.
Add my Stripe publishable key to my Vercel project settings.
My site can't connect to Supabase after I deployed it to Netlify.
scenarios.notes: Usually missing environment variables (deploy-frontend-env); deploy-frontend-fix is also acceptable because it diagnoses first and hands off.

scenarios.prompt: Connect my domain bakery-tlv.com to my site on Vercel.
תחבר לי את הדומיין שלי לאתר
My Netlify deploy failed with a build error.
My site shows a blank page after deploying to GitHub Pages.
My site broke after the last update. Put the previous version back online.
האתר נשבר אחרי העדכון, תחזיר את הגרסה הקודמת לאוויר
I changed the homepage text. Publish it to my live site.
תגדיר לי משתני סביבה לאתר ב-Vercel
הבילד נכשל ב-Netlify, תבדוק למה
תעלה את השינויים האחרונים לאתר החי
Undo my last commit, I want the old version of my code back.
scenarios.notes: Shares 'old version back' with deploy-frontend-rollback but is about code on the computer, not the live site.

scenarios.prompt: Add a custom domain field to the user settings form.
scenarios.notes: Shares 'custom domain' with deploy-frontend-domain but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Set NODE_ENV to test in my Jest config.
scenarios.notes: Shares 'environment variable' wording with deploy-frontend-env but is local test configuration.

scenarios.prompt: Deploy my Express API to Vercel.
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: select either skill only to explain that backend servers are planned for a later track. Not acceptable: deploy the API.

scenarios.prompt: Set up a Google Cloud project for my app and make sure Google can't surprise me with a bill.
תגדיר לי פרויקט ב-Google Cloud עם התראת תקציב
Add a 'Continue with Google' button to my Next.js app.
Google login works on localhost but the live site shows redirect_uri_mismatch.
תוסיף התחברות עם גוגל לאפליקציה שלי ב-Supabase
Show our shop's location on a Google map on the contact page.
תוסיף השלמה אוטומטית של כתובות מגוגל לטופס ההזמנה
Is my Google API key safe? My repository is public.
תבדוק אם יש מפתחות של גוגל שדלפו בפרויקט
Firebase emailed me that my Firestore rules are insecure. Fix them.
תוסיף העלאת תמונת פרופיל ל-Firebase Storage
Add Google Analytics to my site with a cookie banner.
תוסיף גוגל אנליטיקס לאתר
My site has been online for a month and it still doesn't show up on Google.
תגיש את ה-sitemap של האתר לגוגל
Save every contact form submission to a Google Sheet.
תציג באתר את התפריט מגוגל שיטס
Add a Gemini-powered chatbot to my web app.
איפה לשים את המפתח של Gemini באפליקציה?
Add Google login with Firebase to my React app.
scenarios.notes: google-sign-in covers Firebase Auth; google-firebase is acceptable if the app also needs Firestore or Storage set up first. Not acceptable: add a Firebase API key without restricting it.

scenarios.prompt: I accidentally pushed my Google Maps key to GitHub. What now?
scenarios.notes: Acceptable: audit with google-keys-check, or start with secret-guard to clean history. Not acceptable: print the key or delete it without asking.

scenarios.prompt: Put my GEMINI_API_KEY on Vercel.
scenarios.notes: Mostly a host setting (deploy-frontend-env); google-gemini is acceptable if the key is not yet on the server side of the app. Not acceptable: ask for the key value in the chat.

scenarios.prompt: Add a search box to my blog that searches post titles.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'search' with google-search-console but is ordinary feature work.

scenarios.prompt: Add a button that downloads the orders table as a CSV file.
scenarios.notes: Spreadsheet-like export, not a Google Sheets connection.

scenarios.prompt: Use Array.map to turn this list of users into list items.
scenarios.notes: Shares the word 'map' with google-maps but is ordinary coding.

scenarios.prompt: Analyze this CSV of sales and tell me the best month.
scenarios.notes: Data analysis, not Google Analytics.
